_comment: Shipped schema for `extract.py <file> --schema invoice`. Fields are what a Spanish/EU invoice actually has and what a ledger row needs. Everything is optional on purpose: a model forced to fill a required field will INVENT one, and an absent value is far safer than a confident wrong one - validation downstream can only check what is there.

is_invoice.description: true only for an actual invoice or receipt; false for quotes, delivery notes, statements, reminders and anything else

document_kind.description: invoice, credit_note, receipt, quote, delivery_note, statement or other

supplier_tax_id.description: the SUPPLIER's NIF/CIF/VAT number, exactly as printed

line_items.description: one entry per billed line, when the document lists them
